rounded_held_product.source:
`include "disciplines.vams"
module m(u,y,r); input u; output y; inout r; electrical u,y,r; real next;integer n; analog begin @(initial_step)begin next=0.4;n=0;end @(timer(0.01,0,1e-6))next=0.1*V(u,r);@(timer(next,0,1e-6))n=n+1;V(y,r)<+n; end endmodule
